verdict.rationale: Publishing an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a SaaS email product, so the axis applies. A direct probe found https://superhuman.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 404. The MCP feature pages describe a separate MCP-server capability, not docs written for agents to ingest, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
